ui.note: Sign-in and sign-up show Google only when the server publishes it as configured. OAuth callback registration refusals use the same six localized messages as email registration.

release.note: Prepare alpha.12 and Android code12 with the retained signing identity and unchanged protected documentation epoch.

configuration.noImpact: The all-in-one image pins zlib 1.3.2-r1 because Alpine removed r0 from its mirrors. Same zlib upstream version and package set; configuration, deployment steps and documented behavior are unchanged.

deployment.noImpact: The all-in-one image pins zlib 1.3.2-r1 because Alpine removed r0 from its mirrors. Same zlib upstream version and package set; configuration, deployment steps and documented behavior are unchanged.

native.note: Document native export source labels and upload times, separate system save dialogs, retained prepared files after cancellation or save failure, and Saved only after a confirmed write.

authentication.note: OAuth registration denials preserve their stable policy code through Better Auth callback redirects. Native browser sign-in retains the grant ID and displays the localized policy message.

compatibility.note: Document the Zero 1.9 outage recovery patch, retained durable-close behavior and automatic queued-mutation replay without bypassing authentication.
compatibility.upgrade: Upgrade the application and reload open clients to load the corrected client bundle; no database migration or storage format change is required.
compatibility.backup: Take the existing database and attachment backup before upgrading, and retain browser storage until queued edits have reached the server.
compatibility.rollback: Rolling back restores the older client outage defect; reload clients after rollback and verify that queued edits reach the server.
compatibility.clientVersions: Already open older clients need a reload to gain recovery; the patch preserves persisted formats and leaves invalid sessions requiring sign-in.
